
{{alias}}( [x, y,] [options] )
    Returns a line chart instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ArrayLike|ndarray (optional)
        An array-like object or ndarray containing x-coordinate values.

    y: ArrayLike|ndarray|Array (optional)
        An array-like object, an ndarray, or an array of such values
        containing y-coordinate values.

    options: Object (optional)
        Options.

    Returns
    -------
    chart: LineChart
        Line chart instance.

    Examples
    --------
    > var chart = new {{alias}}( [ 1, 2, 3 ], [ 4, 5, 6 ] )
    <LineChart>

    See Also
    --------
